Yan costume.

lines.text: Listen Rookie, two for the price of one is as good as you're going to get.
We do honest business here. I'm serious! Let me guess, you've been burned in the past, yes?
Why are you always so handsy? You're not interested in me, are you?
Keeping your eyes peeled for any opportunities is something any true entrepreneur should be doing.

Do you think I will only want to do business with you?
I'm interested in other things as well.
You are the perfect candidate to be my secretary.
Are you using a calculator? Why don't you say something?
While you're sitting there twiddling your thumbs, prices are rising and shares are fluctuating. You're bound to lose money unless you get up and do something.
Let's start a business, how about it?
I think today's a good day to bring in some customers.
Have you heard? I've got a screw loose, because... I must be insane for offering such amazing deals!
Come to our store if you need anything. We have everything, except for what we don't have!
Pleasure doing business with you.
I see you're not shy about throwing money around.
This feeling, it's... nice.
Is this for me? Thanks!
How did you know I like this kind of thing?
You've really got a good head on your shoulders, Rookie.
You know Rookie, you're kinda cute every once in a while.
What? Have you made up your mind to take things to the next level?
Are you seducing me? You're a player to the core, and you can't convince me otherwise.
Come and make a fortune.
Need me for something?
I'm on my way!
The battle's begun!
Come and make a fortune, Rookie.
The sooner I can wrap this up, the sooner I can leave.
How about I give them a little taste of what I can do?
I'm reloading.
Reloading at once.
Gimme a break!
Right now, Rookie!
Everyone has their price, and I'm about to cash you out.
Time to wrap things up!
One down.
Easy-peasy!
Like taking candy from a baby.
Ah!
Plz!
Ah...
I'm bowing out for now... Sorry.
Is that the best you've got? You've got to be kidding me.
